description: This Java class 'SurveyMapper' provides static methods for mapping between domain objects (Survey, Component, Question, Response) and their corresponding data transfer objects (SurveyData, ComponentData, QuestionData, ResponseData). It facilitates conversion of survey-related data structures within the application.

classes.name: SurveyMapper
classes.description: Utility class for mapping between domain objects and data transfer objects related to surveys.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Converts a Survey domain object into a SurveyData transfer object.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Updates a Survey domain object with data from a SurveyData transfer object.

methods.name: mapComponents
methods.description: Converts a list of Component domain objects into a list of ComponentData objects.

methods.name: mapComponentDatas
methods.description: Converts a list of ComponentData objects into a list of Component domain objects, associating them with a Survey.

methods.name: mapQuestions
methods.description: Converts a list of Question domain objects into a list of QuestionData objects.

methods.name: mapQuestionDatas
methods.description: Converts a list of QuestionData objects into a list of Question domain objects, associating them with a Survey.

methods.name: mapResponses
methods.description: Converts a list of Response domain objects into a list of ResponseData objects.

methods.name: mapResponseDatas
methods.description: Converts a list of ResponseData objects into a list of Response domain objects, associating them with a Question.
